data.body: Last lynx cycle completed per operator instruction. I amended AC6 with concrete metric/alarm mapping and prior-art reuse: reuse/extend scripts/assert_volumes_in_service.py (bug dcc3), metric rebar/host:gate_scratch_volume_in_service, dimensions InstanceId/VolumeId/mount, values IN_SERVICE=1, NOT-IN-SERVICE=0, UNKNOWN=-1, alarm mirroring rebar-gate-scratch-unmounted. The one allowed review still returned BLOCK, so I am leaving this ticket open and unclaimed; no Terraform apply, mount, Docker restart, or code work was performed. Blocking finding verbatim: The plan claims UNKNOWN (-1) 'stays distinct from NOT-IN-SERVICE' and 'remains distinguishable in the metric stream', but never specifies that the new gate_scratch_volume_in_service publisher must emit a value on EVERY recurring tick — including the UNKNOWN path and the case where the check itself cannot run — rather than going silent. Checklist item: Specify that gate_scratch_volume_in_service must publish a value on EVERY recurring observability tick — emitting -1 on the UNKNOWN path and on any path where the terraform/lsblk join cannot complete — never going silent, mirroring the existing gate_scratch_mounted heartbeat-on-every-tick contract.
